findings.adr: NO ADR; tracker/initiatives/collect-evidence-feedback/index.md:108, Implementation Decisions 15, interruption and owned-resource cleanup.
findings.description: Spec line 108: "On Ctrl-C or SIGTERM, stop new work, finish or fail pending saves explicitly, and release owned resources. Do not claim that an interrupted operation completed." collect calls doctor at line 146 before installing signal handlers at lines 159–160 or entering its cleanup try/finally. Playwright doctor opens a real owned browser session at lines 69–76. The standalone doctor command also has no signal handler. [INFERENCE] SIGTERM during that launch/close window terminates the collector instead of awaiting browser.close; an owned daemon browser session can remain open. The retained interruption workflow sends SIGTERM only after the later /interrupt navigation, so its pass does not cover this earlier lifecycle window.
findings.required_change: Put signal handling and owned-resource cleanup around the complete resource-owning command lifecycle, including doctor and its invocation from run. Preserve cancellation state through prerequisite checks, stop before subsequent driver work, and finish owned-session cleanup before exit. Add a public process-level regression for interruption during the prerequisite browser session, while preserving a borrowed session.
